evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check debunked claims that China landed on the Moon's south pole before India, confirming India was the first to land near that region.

evidence.title: Fact Check: India Did NOT Fake Chandrayaan-3 Landing On The ...
evidence.snippet_en: Lead Stories verified that India did not fake the Chandrayaan-3 landing on the Moon, explaining that a simulation was broadcast during the live event.

outputs.notes_en: Fact checks related to specific viral media/claims around the Chandrayaan-3 landing were evaluated; general hoaxes regarding China landing first or the event being staged provide context verifying aspects of the landing.
